## Athlete intake — Google Form to Postgres

Google Form -> Apps Script `onFormSubmit` -> Caddy `/api/athlete-intake` -> this webhook.
Script source of truth: `automation/athlete-intake/onFormSubmit.gs`.

**Auth is a Header Auth credential on the webhook node**, not a comparison inside the workflow. n8n rejects a wrong/missing `X-Intake-Secret` with a 401 before any node runs, and the secret stays in n8n's credential store instead of being baked into this JSON — which is what gets mirrored into the repo.

This chunk only receives and stores. The Gemini briefing is next and reads `athlete_intake`.

Home doc: `athlete-onboarding-flow.md` section 3.6

## Briefing del atleta con Gemini

Corre despues de guardar el intake. Lee el formulario, escribe el briefing para Ivan, lo guarda en `athlete_intake.briefing`, lo manda por mail y avisa por Telegram.

**Credencial `Gemini API`**: Header Auth, nombre `x-goog-api-key`, valor = la misma GOOGLE_API_KEY que usa Hermes.

Modelo: `gemini-3.1-pro-preview` (el mismo del blog writer), fijado dentro de `Build Briefing Prompt`. Pro y no flash a proposito: esto corre unas pocas veces por mes y la nota 7 del doc de infra registra a flash narrando exito con output roto.

El prompt esta condensado de `methodology.md` 2, 3 y 5. Si cambia la metodologia, se actualiza aca.

parameters.query: SELECT id FROM athlete_intake WHERE email = $1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1;

parameters.subject: =Briefing: {{ $('Normalize Intake').item.json.full_name }} ({{ $('Normalize Intake').item.json.sport }})
